description: Run a live audit of a website's readiness to be found and quoted by answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and classic search. Fetches the home page and a few internal pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt, then returns an AI-readiness score (0-100), an SEO hygiene score and pass/warn/fail checks with their meaning. Use it when the user asks whether their site is visible in AI answers or what to fix first.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

name: audit_ai_readiness
title: Audit a site's AI-search readiness
